moments.title: Stockman House, Mason City
moments.text: Frank Lloyd Wright designed this Prairie house in 1908 from his plan for "A Fireproof House for $5000", and at auction in 1987 its only bidder wanted a parking lot.

moments.title: Iowa Falls
moments.text: The town gave up its first name, Rocksylvania, as too hard to spell, and here the Iowa River runs through a limestone gorge 70 feet deep.
